title: Find SUSE's status for a CVE
subtitle: Search the Tickets, open one, and read its packages

outro.title: Search finds more than CVEs
outro.subtitle: Search for a Ticket or a package the same way.

chapters.title: Find SUSE's status for a CVE

steps.caption: Search for the CVE
steps.narration: From the Ticket list, type the identifier of the CVE in the search.

steps.caption: Press Enter to search
steps.narration: Press Enter. The list keeps the Tickets that match: here, the Ticket of the CVE.

steps.caption: Open its Ticket
steps.narration: Select the Ticket to open it.

steps.caption: Its status and priority come first
steps.narration: The heading of the Ticket shows its CVE, its status, its severity, and its priority.

steps.caption: The packages show SUSE's status for each Product
steps.narration: Below, the packages show where SUSE stands for each Product and codestream: affected, and whether the fix is released.
